patch_description: This crossover keeps the current program’s repaired, diverse QAOA seeds and occasional recombination, while adopting the inspiration program’s LP-detail-guided exchange search. It queries bottleneck details only once per parent, uses those signals and demand to shortlist swaps before calling the energy proxy, and limits each LP batch to promising moves plus a few exploratory choices. Bounded archives and lightweight random kicks aim to preserve useful diversity without the current program’s costly repeated full-neighborhood generation and ranking.
